'''Jellion Broon''' was a famous [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] actor in the [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. While in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] as part of a race story he was acting in, Broon became obsessed with the planet's deserts and wandered off to explore the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]]. Six months later Broon reappeared, though the twin suns of Tatooine and the wind left him looking weathered and old, with his own agent no longer recognizing him and his former studio employer not wanting to deal with him.<ref name="Kenobi" />

[[Annileen Calwell]] would later use the story of Broon as an example to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] about the importance of keeping his hood on when working under the twin suns of Tatooine.<ref name="Kenobi" />
